Keeping it honest: on their own, recent games (form) say 61% and the matchup 77%. The sportsbooks are usually close to right, and these methods have only partly beaten them (weights measured on NFL week 2), so we pull them most of the way toward the market: form 52%, matchup 55%.
Bottom line: we give it 55% to win and it needs 53%. The edge is the difference: +1.8 points; that works out to about +3¢ per $1 bet over the long run.
